subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “He had not only grown crops.”?
options: Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.
It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.
He had recorded a changing world, one day at a time.

本文沒有陳述「It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

本文可直接核對「He had not only grown crops. He had recorded a changing world, one day at a time.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
